title: Sign in and reach the monthly dashboard
description: Verifies that the admin can sign in with valid credentials and land on the current-month salary status view.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the sign-in form
Verify the monthly dashboard is displayed
Verify employee salary statuses are displayed

title: Mark an employee as paid for the current month
description: Verifies that an unpaid employee can be marked paid with a valid payment date and the monthly status updates accordingly.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the sign-in form
Click the navigation link to open the monthly dashboard
Click the mark as paid control for an unpaid employee
Fill in a valid payment date into the payment date field
Submit the payment form
Verify the employee is marked paid
Verify the payment date is shown in the monthly status table

title: Show validation errors when creating an incomplete employee
description: Verifies that required employee fields and invalid values are rejected with field-level validation while preserving user input.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the sign-in form
Click the navigation link to open the employee list
Fill in the name field with TC013 Validation Employee
Fill in the designation field with QA Candidate
Fill in a future date of birth (2099-01-01) into the date of birth field. It is a native date input, so non-date text such as "not-a-date" cannot be entered at all
Fill in the monthly salary field with not-a-number
Submit the employee form
Verify the field-level errors "Date of birth must be in the past." and "Salary must be a number with at most 2 decimal places." are visible below their fields
Verify the name, designation, date of birth (2099-01-01) and monthly salary (not-a-number) inputs still contain the entered values
